title: Kembali Warung
notes: The Google Maps place-panel menu tab — the path most production menu analyses actually take, and the one the corpus never covered. Markup is nothing like a restaurant's own site: div soup, no <ul>, no sections, prices interleaved, and the page carries review/rating/hours chrome the extractor has to drop. Two dishes (Tempeh Goreng, Es Kelapa Muda) have no description at all, so their verdict has to come from the name. `request.source`/`restaurant_name` mirror what the Maps extractor sends; the name reaches the model as the title (analysis_core._run_analysis).
